Hostfix Fika COOP For OP Dev

Have a hotfix for this. Although I should note I know next to nothing about CSharp or mod dev, and decide to try and fix this myself. Hopefuilly OP Mod Dev can give a better spin on this.

The issues seems to stem from DoorBreachComponent.Enable function where the condition of

Singleton<IBotGame>.Instantiatedis always false, meaning the configuration never executes in a COOP game for any other players apart from the Host.

While I’m sure someone with way more knowledge than me can fix this is an more elegant way, removing the above condition fixes the issue for all players in COOP Fika match. Changing the original method from :

public static void Enable() { if (Singleton<IBotGame>.Instantiated) { var gameWorld = Singleton<GameWorld>.Instance; gameWorld.GetOrAddComponent<DoorBreachComponent>(); } }To this:

public static void Enable() { var gameWorld = Singleton<GameWorld>.Instance; gameWorld.GetOrAddComponent<DoorBreachComponent>(); }Hope this helps some of you
